notice: Published offers, not an entitlement or live quota check. No automatic billing or provider fallback.

providers.name: Gemini Developer API
providers.offer: Free input/output for Gemini Flash TTS; account/model rate limits apply. Pro TTS is not free.
providers.cautions: Account/region eligibility applies. Review applicable data-use terms; do not submit sensitive material to a demo account.

providers.name: Groq Orpheus
providers.offer: Free Plan: Orpheus 10 requests/minute, 100/day, plus token limits; 200 input characters/request.
providers.cautions: Only six English voices. Tags count towards the 200-character cap. Quotas can differ by account.

providers.name: Hume Octave
providers.cautions: Octave 1 is selected for acting instructions. Octave 2 description support is not yet documented as available. Use an Octave-1-compatible voice; check plan licensing.

providers.name: Cartesia Sonic
providers.offer: Free: 20,000 credits/month; consumption depends on the model.
providers.cautions: Free is for non-commercial testing; pricing places commercial use on paid plans. Emotion control is guidance, not exact acting.

providers.name: ElevenLabs
providers.offer: Free API allowance: 10,000 characters for v3; model-specific allowances and restrictions apply.
providers.cautions: Review free-plan attribution and commercial-use restrictions. Some voices/models/formats are plan restricted.

providers.name: Azure Speech
providers.cautions: Select F0 explicitly; S0 is a different billing tier. Styles depend on voice and region. Resource/account eligibility applies.

providers.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
providers.offer: 10,000 Neurons/day shared across Workers AI models; resets at 00:00 UTC.
providers.cautions: Direct REST; no Worker deployment required. Free plan stops at quota, while paid plans can charge overage. No free-form acting control.

providers.name: Google Cloud Text-to-Speech
providers.offer: Monthly free usage: Neural2 1M characters; Standard/WaveNet pricing lists 4M. Default here is Neural2.
providers.cautions: Billing and API enablement required; overages may auto-charge. Distinct from Gemini Developer API. OAuth access token is supported as an alternative; Chirp/Gemini Cloud voices are not selected by this adapter.

providers.name: Voice RSS
providers.offer: Free: 350 requests/day; text limit 100 KB/request; this skill uses much shorter clips.
providers.cautions: Basic narration/preview, not theatrical emotional control. SSML is not part of the free plan; adapter sends plain text.
